subject: ACME.dev co-hosted webinar invite: copy, tracking, and RSVP cadence
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: ACME.dev co-hosted webinar invite: copy, tracking, and RSVP cadence

Team — looping you in on ACME.dev co-host opportunity. They want an Architect-focused 45min webinar (short demo + product talk) targeted at platform/infra engineers. High-level asks: co-branded invite, one joint intro slide, and ACME wants a short excerpt in their newsletter (internal blast).

Goals: drive 250 registrants, 75 qualified engineers, and 3 demo requests for SDRs.

What I need from you:
- Marissa: two_cta invite copy variants (developer-focused + platform-focused).
- Ben: tracking links per cohort + UTM map (ACME requires source tagging by newsletter, linkedin, and direct invite).
- Stephanie: RSVP reminder cadence matrix (timezones: PT/ET/EU) and confirmation email content.

Attachments: initial agenda and rough dates attached (acme_cohost_invite_copy_v2.docx).

Timing: ACME wants live April 8. We should lock invite copy + tracking by Feb 12 so their PM can calendar the newsletter send on Feb 16.

Thanks — I’ll draft the first invite and send for quick review tomorrow.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME.dev co-hosted webinar invite: copy, tracking, and RSVP cadence

Camila — thanks for the overview. Quick edits and a proposed cadence below.

Invite copy variants (high level):
1) Developer variant (short): "How teams cut inference costs 3x without slowing developers — live demo + tradeoffs"
2) Platform/Architect variant (technical): "Serving LLMs at scale: latency vs. cost playbook (with ACME.dev)"

I attached a doc with 2 subject line tests and preheader options — please review acme_cohost_invite_copy_v2.docx.

Tracking & UTMs (Ben to confirm): set utm_source values: "acme_newsletter", "acme_linkedin", "acme_direct_invite". Add hubspot campaign ID and hubspot_contact_id capture on landing.

RSVP cadence (first pass):
- Initial invite send (day 0)
- Reminder 1 (day 3)
- Reminder 2 (day 7)
- Final reminder 1 business day before (time based by timezone)

Timezones: recommend rolling sends by local TZ windows (PT 10am, ET 11am, EU 3pm local). Stephanie, can you create the schedule sheet and mapping?

I also recommend the following slate of tracking links and a short form (name, email, company, job function, interest checkbox "inference/perf/cost").

If ACME's newsletter slot is Feb 16, we should finalize copy and landing page link by Feb 13 EOD.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Growth Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@acme.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Tuttle <jamie@acme.dev>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: ACME.dev co-hosted webinar invite: copy, tracking, and RSVP cadence

Thanks Camila — Alex here on the ACME events team, copying Jamie (product). We're excited to co-host. A few items from our side:

- Newsletter slot confirmed for Feb 16 (internal send).
- We need the final invite HTML and one tracking link by Feb 13 so the comms team can insert it.
- Please make sure the landing page collects the hubspot_contact_id param (we will pass lead source to our CRM).

One ask: can you provide two short (25–35 word) speaker blurbs for our newsletter? Also send a 600x200 speaker image for the email.

If possible, include a LinkedIn copy version (short) we can post the same day.

Looking forward — Alex

Subject: Re: ACME.dev co-hosted webinar invite: copy, tracking, and RSVP cadence

Alex / Jamie — great, thanks for confirming the slot. Per your asks:
- Attached are two speaker blurbs (25–30 words) and a single 600x200 image link (hosted in our CDN).
- Final invite HTML will be sent by Feb 13 EOD and Ben will drop the primary tracking link (utm_source=acme_newsletter) into the sheet.
- Landing page will capture hubspot_contact_id and include hidden fields for utm_campaign and utm_medium.

Quick summary of next steps and owners:
- Marissa: finalize two subject lines + preheaders by Feb 12 noon PT (status: draft in acme_cohost_invite_copy_v2.docx).
- Ben: publish tracking links sheet and primary newsletter URL by Feb 13 9am PT (file invite_tracking_links_v1.csv).
- Stephanie: upload RSVP cadence matrix and timezone send windows by Feb 12 EOD (rsvp_cadence_matrix.xlsx).
- Camila: provide final invite HTML and speaker assets by Feb 13 EOD.

Links:
- Draft tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-tracking_links_example
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-3245

ACME — please confirm the newsletter creative drop time on Feb 16 (AM/PM) so we can time the UTM landing to your send.

Thanks everyone — on it.

—Camila
